Description.SourceString:
Nobody likes a meeting with their manager, and nowhere is that truer than in Kuldra's Tower. Kuldra would summon her troops to her chamber, and those troops would do their best to look attentive while cowering behind their shields. An onlooker might have enjoyed how the troops would poke their heads above when Kuldra's mouths were closed, and then duck behind when they were open. 

Kuldra was too wise to miss this pattern. She would often treat herself, opening her mouths in sequence. She would enjoy how much her troops looked like moles, poking their heads in and out of their holes.
